profile.headline: Software Engineer II at FIS
profile.summary:
I’m a Software Engineer II specializing in UI/UX and front-end development, currently building intuitive and user-centered digital experiences at FIS Amount. My work focuses on creating accessible, responsive, and maintainable interfaces using technologies such as React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

Previously, I worked at Scholastic, where I helped build engaging educational platforms used by a diverse audience of students and educators. I collaborated closely with designers, engineers, and cross-functional teams to translate complex requirements and designs into accessible, high-quality user experiences.

I graduated from Oberlin College with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, where I developed a strong foundation in software engineering, problem-solving, and both front-end and back-end development.

Beyond engineering, my background as a collegiate student-athlete has shaped how I approach my work. I bring a competitive mindset, discipline, resilience, and a team-first mentality to everything I do. I enjoy solving challenging problems, learning new technologies, and building products that make a meaningful impact.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack associate software engineer working at the forefront of shaping engaging and interactive educational platforms that cater to a diverse young audience. Specializing in Front-End development for the Education Solutions domain, I collaborate closely with UX/UI designers to ensure design integrity across digital platforms. I am deeply involved in utilizing HTML, CSS, JavaScript and front-end frameworks like React.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Back-End Web Development

positions.title: Main Library Circulation Desk Attendant
positions.description: Assists library patrons with any library questions regarding printing, locating books, reserving books, and more. Monitors library activity, as well as checking books in and out and shelving books.

positions.title: Development Intern
positions.description: Collaborated with the development team to organize files, assist with bug fixes, and other day-to-day tasks. Assisted and resolved clients' concerns regarding the Kokomo software.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
Provides math tutoring to individual students and small groups with students in grades kindergarten through ninth grade within Oberlin City School District classrooms and community after-school programs. Works to help students develop mathematical curiosity by building
strong, positive student-tutor relationships, while also lowering teacher-student ratios in the classroom.

positions.title: Bold and Cold: Leadership Program
positions.description: Engages in workshops created to help gain a deeper understanding of the foundations of effective and innovative leadership, becoming financially responsible, identifying and articulating personal goals and ambitions for life after college, and empowering oneself to realize these goals and ambitions. Collaborates with peers in group reflection sessions to develop public speaking and leadership skills

positions.title: Summer Camp Counselor
positions.description: Led and supervised more than 10 kids ranging from 5 years old to 11 years old. Communicated and collaborated with 50 other camp counselors over a period of 10 weeks in order to provide a fun and safe camp experience for the kids.

positions.title: Coach
positions.description: Led a community-based training program for all athletes with intellectual, emotional, and/or physical disabilities. Strived to provide soccer opportunities for players to develop at their own pace in a safe, fun, and supportive/inclusive environment.
